'''Red Cabbage Seeds''' are a type of seed that can be found:
* at [[Pierre's General Store]] for {{Price|100}} starting in Year 2.
* at the Magic Shop Boat at the [[Night Market]] on Winter 16 for {{Price|100}} starting in Year 2.
* at the [[Traveling Cart]] occasionally for {{Tprice|50}}, and [[Traveling Cart#Guaranteed Red Cabbage|guaranteed]] on at least one day in Year 1 if the "Guarantee Year 1 Completable" [[Options#Advanced Game Options|Advanced Option]] was enabled.
* in a [[Seed Maker]] from a processed [[Red Cabbage]].
* in the [[Skull Cavern]] from slain [[Mummy|Mummies]] (0.2% chance), slain [[Serpent]]s (0.2% chance), slain [[Slimes|Purple Slimes]] (0.125% chance)<ref name="purplesludge" />, or [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] (≈0.09% chance for 5 to 20 seeds).

Mature plants yield [[Red Cabbage]].
